summary: One new deal today: a cashback stack brings the Breville Barista Express to about $490. Yesterday's robot vacuum and TV deals are still listed.

top.item: Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow (robot vacuum + mop, self-empty dock)
top.saving: About 22% below the best street price
top.why: Covers both vacuuming and mopping, and the dock empties itself.

Listed at $599. TopCashback pays 20% back on orders over $150.01 with no cap, calculated on the pre-GST price (about $545), so roughly $109 back. Built-in grinder and a proper steam wand. Cashback arrives later and only pays if your click is tracked; check the listing is the BES870 sold by Woolworths.
Costco membership required. Product page may now show out of stock, so check first. Note it's a 60Hz panel.

deals.why: Kit includes 2 batteries and a charger; the batteries fit all Ozito PXC 18V tools. Cuts 41cm, just over the 33–40cm target. Stock is patchy (item number 1108457).
